Consent.title: {client} wants access to your account
Consent.redirectsTo: After you decide, you will be sent to {host}.
Consent.switchLabel: Use a different account, now signed in as {email}
Consent.retry: Something went wrong on our side and your choice was not saved. Try again.
Consent.error.title: This request can't be completed
Consent.error.body: Go back to the app you came from and start again.
Scope.profile: See your name and profile picture
Changes.note: Allowing gives the app access to what it asked for, in your name, and sends you back to it with a one-time code; it keeps that access until you take it back in your account. Denying sends you back with nothing.
